title: Dirichlet-Neumann Waveform Relaxation Method for Hyperbolic PDE with Time Delay in Multiple Subdomains
summary: Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) with time delay are essential mathematical tools used to model numerous physical systems where wave propagation or oscillations depend heavily on their historical states. As these applications scale in physical complexity, efficient parallel computing techniques become essential; however, developing highly scalable parallel solvers for delayed PDEs remains a significant computational challenge.
